metadata.description: The X Factor kit: safety and visibility mods for Claude Code beginners.

plugins.name: kit-guide
plugins.description: Explains the X Factor kit: a one-time welcome above the prompt and /kit, a pane listing what each mod does and how to use it.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Stops destructive shell commands, lists exactly what they would delete or discard, and waits for a person to press Approve.

plugins.name: file-tree
plugins.description: A right-side pane showing, live, which files Claude is reading, editing and committing. No model calls; history kept across sessions.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: After Claude edits files, a Replay button steps through each edit as a before/after diff. No model calls; the last 60 edits are kept across sessions.

plugins.name: cash-tax
plugins.description: Warns before an idle session's prompt cache expires and the next message re-reads the whole conversation at full price, with the token count and cost. /keepwarm pings the cache to keep it alive.
